scope: Documentation-only population for five frozen RB1 core capabilities
hard_rule: Any implementation delta or adverse reinterpretation fails this audit.

items.rationale: No kernel or alternate kernel is created; documentation only.
No I/O enters the kernel and no file-format contract changes.
CORE-DATA explicitly documents rather than changes the frozen data-category separation.
No persistent state layout changes; documentation does not add state.
No scratch ownership changes; frozen worker/job-local semantics remain unchanged.
No storage-layout or batching implementation changes.
CORE-TRANSACTION documents the frozen checkpoint/trial/retry/commit semantics without changing them.
No recomputation or warm-start behaviour changes.
CORE-INTERVAL explicitly preserves generic [t0,t1] semantics and no calendar assumption is introduced.
No coupling-window implementation or restriction changes.
No coupling seam is removed or redefined.
No groundwater interface contract change is made.
CORE-MASS documents the accepted-only hard mass ledger; mass conservation remains non-negotiable and unchanged.
No interface-sensitivity implementation or claim changes.
No coupling cost path is changed or claimed.
No MultiSWAP runtime implementation changes.
No MODFLOW cell/tile mapping assumption is introduced.
No deep-vadose component is introduced or reinterpreted.
No component transition storage semantics change.
No soil-water solver interface or implementation changes.
No duplicate process physics is introduced.
No module dependency on HeadCalc internals is added.
No physics option or numerical policy changes; F-DOC03 keeps those dimensions separate.
No runtime cost/fallback policy is altered or newly claimed.
REFERENCE mode remains unchanged and available.
CORE-DIAGNOSTICS documents the frozen diagnostics contract without changing its fields or semantics.
No optional functionality is made mandatory and no memory allocation changes occur.
No runtime/coupler composition responsibility moves into the kernel.
No hidden midnight/day/file/MODFLOW assumptions are introduced; generic interval semantics are explicit.
This file explicitly audits all 30 invariants for F-DOC03.
